name: CAMM Metals, Inc.
old_description: At CAMM Metals, our team specializes in MIG and TIG welding techniques. Whether working with steel, stainless steel, or aluminum, our skilled welders ensure precise and durable welds that meet the highest quality standards.
about:
CAMM Metals, Inc. was founded in 1996 by Al Soucie in his household garage in East Windsor, Connecticut. The company, named for his family members Craig, Al, Marge, and Matt, began as a one-man operation with an iron worker and a kerosene heater. By 1997 it moved into a 3,000‑square‑foot building, and today it operates as a second‑generation, family‑owned job shop from a 17,000‑square‑foot facility in the same town.

The shop provides full‑service sheet metal fabrication, including laser cutting, laser tube cutting, water jet cutting, MIG and TIG welding, CNC machining, and 3D printing. It handles small lots and batch runs up to 10,000 pieces, producing small‑ to medium‑sized fabrications, weldments, and OEM equipment for industrial customers. The plant is ISO 9001 certified and runs on CAD‑driven equipment designed for tight tolerances and intricate geometries.

CAMM Metals serves OEMs across New England and New York State, supporting a broad range of industries since 1996. Its customer base includes manufacturers requiring precision metal parts in steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, plastics, and exotic alloys such as Inconel and titanium.

The company emphasizes continuous improvement, reinvesting profits into new technology and cloud‑based workflow tools to shorten lead times and improve quality. Its single‑source model covers cutting, bending, fabricating, and welding, aiming to deliver high‑quality metal parts on schedule.
